name: ImbalancedChen.exists_firstExitRetainedLeaf_of_validSelection
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (retained : Bool → List.{u_1} α → Bool) (h : α → Real) {chosen remaining : List.{u_1} α}
  (hsub : @List.Sublist.{u_1} α chosen remaining) (pre : List.{u_1} α) (positive : Bool) (mass : Real)
  (hvalid : @ImbalancedChen.FirstExitValidSelection.{u_1} α retained pre positive chosen),
  @Exists.{u_1 + 1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α) fun (leaf : ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α) =>
    And
      (@Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α)
        (List.{u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α))
        (@List.instMembership.{u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α))
        (@ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedLeaves.{u_1} α retained h pre positive mass remaining) leaf)
      (@Eq.{u_1 + 1} (List.{u_1} α) (@ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.selected.{u_1} α leaf)
        (@HAppend.hAppend.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (List.{u_1} α) (List.{u_1} α) (List.{u_1} α)
          (@instHAppendOfAppend.{u_1} (List.{u_1} α) (@List.instAppend.{u_1} α)) (@List.reverse.{u_1} α chosen) pre))

name: ImbalancedChen.exists_validSelection_of_mem_firstExitRetainedLeaves
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} (retained : Bool → List.{u_1} α → Bool) (h : α → Real) (pre remaining : List.{u_1} α) (positive : Bool)
  (mass : Real) (leaf : ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α)
  (hleaf :
    @Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α)
      (List.{u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α))
      (@List.instMembership.{u_1} (ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.{u_1} α))
      (@ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedLeaves.{u_1} α retained h pre positive mass remaining) leaf),
  @Exists.{u_1 + 1} (List.{u_1} α) fun (chosen : List.{u_1} α) =>
    And (@List.Sublist.{u_1} α chosen remaining)
      (And (@ImbalancedChen.FirstExitValidSelection.{u_1} α retained pre positive chosen)
        (@Eq.{u_1 + 1} (List.{u_1} α) (@ImbalancedChen.FirstExitLeaf.selected.{u_1} α leaf)
          (@HAppend.hAppend.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (List.{u_1} α) (List.{u_1} α) (List.{u_1} α)
            (@instHAppendOfAppend.{u_1} (List.{u_1} α) (@List.instAppend.{u_1} α)) (@List.reverse.{u_1} α chosen) pre)))

name: ImbalancedChen.mem_firstExitRetainedModuli_iff_validSelection
type:
∀ (retained : Bool → List.{0} Nat → Bool) (carrier : List.{0} Nat) (d : Nat),
  Iff
    (@Membership.mem.{0, 0} Nat (Finset.{0} Nat)
      (@SetLike.instMembership.{0, 0} (Finset.{0} Nat) Nat (@Finset.instSetLike.{0} Nat))
      (ImbalancedChen.firstExitRetainedModuli retained carrier) d)
    (@Exists.{1} (List.{0} Nat) fun (chosen : List.{0} Nat) =>
      And (@List.Sublist.{0} Nat chosen carrier)
        (And (@ImbalancedChen.FirstExitValidSelection.{0} Nat retained (@List.nil.{0} Nat) Bool.true chosen)
          (@Eq.{1} Nat (@List.prod.{0} Nat instMulNat Nat.instOne chosen) d)))

name: ImbalancedChen.mem_firstExitRetainedModuli_iff_validSelection._simp_1_1
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq.{u_1 + 1} α] {l : List.{u_1} α} {a : α},
  @Eq.{1} Prop
    (@Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} α (Finset.{u_1} α)
      (@SetLike.instMembership.{u_1, u_1} (Finset.{u_1} α) α (@Finset.instSetLike.{u_1} α))
      (@List.toFinset.{u_1} α inst l) a)
    (@Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} α (List.{u_1} α) (@List.instMembership.{u_1} α) l a)

name: ImbalancedChen.mem_firstExitRetainedModuli_iff_validSelection._simp_1_2
type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {b : β} {f : α → β} {l : List.{u_1} α},
  @Eq.{1} Prop
    (@Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} β (List.{u_2} β) (@List.instMembership.{u_2} β) (@List.map.{u_1, u_2} α β f l) b)
    (@Exists.{u_1 + 1} α fun (a : α) =>
      And (@Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} α (List.{u_1} α) (@List.instMembership.{u_1} α) l a) (@Eq.{u_2 + 1} β (f a) b))
